name: Yoridori ~Miwaku no Katarogu Yuugi~
original_name: ヨリドリ　～魅惑の型禄遊戯～
source:
Main character enters the prestigious girls academy that starts to accept males from this year. He hopes that he finally escapes the world of bullying, but he's noticed by bully girls from the first day. He manages to find a book with hidden lewd magic. This will definitely help change his position.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角进入了从今年起开始招收男生的著名女子学园。他希望自己终于能逃离欺凌的世界，但他从第一天起就被欺负女孩注意到了。他设法找到一本隐藏着淫荡魔法的书。这肯定有助于改变他的立场。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
